encoding, including its unique nullary tuple. -/

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackTuples.tuples_eq_canonical
statement:
theorem tuples_eq_canonical (n k : Nat) :
    tuples n k = (Lax979537.StructureEncoding.tuples n k).map tupleValues
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [tuples, Lax979537.StructureEncoding.tuples, List.map_flatMap,
        ← List.map_coe_finRange_eq_range]
      simp only [List.flatMap_map]
      congr 1
      funext i
      rw [ih]
      simp [List.map_map, Function.comp_def, tupleValues_cons]

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackTuples.tuples_length
statement: theorem tuples_length (n k : Nat) : (tuples n k).length = n ^ k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [tuples]
  | succ k ih =>
      simp [tuples, List.length_flatMap, ih, List.sum_replicate, Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_comm]

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackTuples.packTuple_const
statement:
theorem packTuple_const (s : BitStore K Aux) (slots : List (K × K))
    (a : α) (values remaining : List Nat) (scratch : Option Bool) :
    packTuple (fun _ : α => s) slots a values remaining scratch =
      packTuple (fun _ : Unit => s) slots () values remaining scratch
proof:
:= by
  induction slots generalizing s values remaining with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons slot slots ih => exact ih _ _ _

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackTuples.packTuple_state
statement:
theorem packTuple_state (base : α → BitStore K Aux) (slots : List (K × K))
    (a : α) (values remaining : List Nat) (scratch : Option Bool) :
    (packTuple base slots a values remaining scratch).state = ((base a).state.1, scratch)
proof:
:= by
  induction slots generalizing base values remaining with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons slot slots ih => exact ih _ _ _

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackTuples.packTuple_stk_scratch
statement:
theorem packTuple_stk_scratch (base : α → BitStore K Aux) (slots : List (K × K))
    (a : α) (values remaining : List Nat) (scratch : Option Bool) :
    (packTuple base slots a values remaining scratch).stk =
      (packTuple base slots a values remaining none).stk
proof:
:= by
  induction slots generalizing base values remaining with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons slot slots ih =>
      rw [packTuple, ih, packTuple_pack_scratch]
      rfl

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackTuples.packTuple_fresh
statement:
theorem packTuple_fresh (base : α → BitStore K Aux) (slots : List (K × K))
    (key : K) (hfresh : key ∉ ports slots) (a : α) (values remaining : List Nat)
    (scratch : Option Bool) :
    (packTuple base slots a values remaining scratch).stk key = (base a).stk key
proof:
:= by
  induction slots generalizing base values remaining with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons slot slots ih =>
      rcases slot with ⟨counter, coord⟩
      have h : key ≠ counter ∧ key ≠ coord ∧ key ∉ ports slots := by simpa [ports] using hfresh
      rw [packTuple, ih _ h.2.2, pack_fresh base counter coord key h.1 h.2.1]

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackTuples.pack_setStack
statement:
theorem pack_setStack (base : α → BitStore K Aux) (counter coord key : K)
    (hcounter : key ≠ counter) (hcoord : key ≠ coord) (bits : α → List Bool)
    (a : α) (i remaining : Nat) (scratch : Option Bool) :
    pack (fun a => setStack (base a) key (bits a)) counter coord a i remaining scratch =
      setStack (pack base counter coord a i remaining scratch) key (bits a)
proof:
:= by
  apply Store.ext
  · rfl
  · funext j
    by_cases hj : j = key <;> simp_all [pack, working, setStack, Function.update_apply]

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackTuples.packTuple_setStack
statement:
theorem packTuple_setStack (base : α → BitStore K Aux) (slots : List (K × K))
    (key : K) (hfresh : key ∉ ports slots) (bits : α → List Bool)
    (a : α) (values remaining : List Nat) (scratch : Option Bool) :
    packTuple (fun a => setStack (base a) key (bits a)) slots a values remaining scratch =
      setStack (packTuple base slots a values remaining scratch) key (bits a)
proof:
:= by
  induction slots generalizing base values remaining with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons slot slots ih =>
      rcases slot with ⟨counter, coord⟩
      have h : key ≠ counter ∧ key ≠ coord ∧ key ∉ ports slots := by simpa [ports] using hfresh
      simp only [packTuple, pack_setStack base counter coord key h.1 h.2.1]
      exact ih _ h.2.2 _ _

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackUnary.splitUnary_le
statement: theorem splitUnary_le (xs : List Bool) : (splitUnary xs).1 ≤ xs.length
proof:
:= by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp [splitUnary]
  | cons b xs ih => cases b <;> simp [splitUnary]; omega

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackUnary.splitUnary_correct
statement:
theorem splitUnary_correct (xs : List Bool) :
    Decoding.readUnary xs = (splitUnary xs).2.map (fun rest => ((splitUnary xs).1, rest))
proof:
:= by
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons b xs ih =>
      cases b with
      | false => rfl
      | true =>
          simp only [Decoding.readUnary, splitUnary, ih]
          cases (splitUnary xs).2 <;> rfl

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackUnary.splitUnary_rest_le
statement:
theorem splitUnary_rest_le (xs : List Bool) :
    ((splitUnary xs).2.getD []).length ≤ xs.length
proof:
:= by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp [splitUnary]
  | cons b xs ih => cases b <;> simp only [splitUnary, List.length_cons, Option.getD_some] <;> omega

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackUnary.loop_executes
statement:
theorem loop_executes [DecidableEq K] (base : K → List Bool) (src counter : K)
    (hne : src ≠ counter) (xs ys : List Bool) (a : Aux) :
    Executes (loop src counter)
      (working base src counter xs.tail ys a xs.head?)
      (working base src counter ((splitUnary xs).2.getD [])
        (List.replicate (splitUnary xs).1 true ++ ys) a (finished (splitUnary xs).2))
      (3 * (splitUnary xs).1 + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction xs generalizing ys with
  | nil => exact Executes.loop_false rfl
  | cons b xs ih =>
      cases b with
      | false => exact Executes.loop_false rfl
      | true =>
          have hp := Executes.atom (.push counter (fun _ : Aux × Option Bool => true))
            (working base src counter xs ys a (some true))
          have hpush : Op.apply (.push counter (fun _ : Aux × Option Bool => true))
              (working base src counter xs ys a (some true)) =
              working base src counter xs (true :: ys) a (some true) := by
            apply Store.ext
            · rfl
            · funext k
              by_cases hk : k = counter <;> simp_all [Op.apply, working]
          rw [hpush] at hp
          have hr := Executes.atom
            (.pop src (fun s : Aux × Option Bool => fun b => (s.1, b)))
            (working base src counter xs (true :: ys) a (some true))
          rw [pop_working base src counter hne] at hr
          have hh := Executes.loop_true (p := body src counter)
            (b := fun s : Aux × Option Bool => s.2 == some true) rfl
            (Executes.seq hp hr) (ih (true :: ys))
          have ht : (1 + 1) + (3 * (splitUnary xs).1 + 1) + 1 =
              3 * ((splitUnary xs).1 + 1) + 1 := by omega
          simpa only [splitUnary, List.tail_cons, List.head?_cons, List.replicate_succ',
            List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append, ht] using hh

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackUnary.parse_executes
statement:
theorem parse_executes [DecidableEq K] (base : K → List Bool) (src counter : K)
    (hne : src ≠ counter) (xs ys : List Bool) (a : Aux) (scratch : Option Bool) :
    Executes (parse src counter) (working base src counter xs ys a scratch)
      (working base src counter ((splitUnary xs).2.getD [])
        (List.replicate (splitUnary xs).1 true ++ ys) a (finished (splitUnary xs).2))
      (3 * (splitUnary xs).1 + 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hr := Executes.atom (.pop src (fun s : Aux × Option Bool => fun b => (s.1, b)))
    (working base src counter xs ys a scratch)
  rw [pop_working base src counter hne] at hr
  have h := Executes.seq hr (loop_executes base src counter hne xs ys a)
  have ht : 1 + (3 * (splitUnary xs).1 + 1) = 3 * (splitUnary xs).1 + 2 := by omega
  simpa only [ht] using h

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackUnary.parse_linear_bound
statement:
theorem parse_linear_bound (xs : List Bool) :
    3 * (splitUnary xs).1 + 2 ≤ 3 * xs.length + 2
proof:
:= by
  have := splitUnary_le xs
  omega

name: Lax979537Proofs.StructureEncoding.tuples_length
statement: theorem tuples_length (n k : Nat) : (tuples n k).length = n ^ k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [tuples]
  | succ k ih =>
      simp [tuples, List.length_flatMap, ih, List.sum_replicate,
        Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_comm]

name: Lax979537Proofs.StructureEncoding.mem_tuples
statement: theorem mem_tuples (n k : Nat) (a : Fin k → Fin n) : a ∈ tuples n k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      have h : a = Fin.elim0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      simp [tuples, h]
  | succ k ih =>
      apply List.mem_flatMap.mpr
      refine ⟨a 0, by simp, ?_⟩
      exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨Fin.tail a, ih _, Fin.cons_self_tail a⟩

name: Lax979537Proofs.StructureEncoding.unary_length
statement: theorem unary_length (n : Nat) : (unary n).length = n + 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [unary]

name: Lax979537Proofs.StructureEncoding.map_get_finRange
statement:
theorem map_get_finRange (σ : Vocabulary) (f : Nat → Nat) :
    ((List.finRange σ.length).map fun r => f (σ.get r)) = σ.map f
proof:
:= by
  change List.map (f ∘ σ.get) (List.finRange σ.length) = σ.map f
  rw [← List.map_map, List.map_get_finRange]

/

conclusion: Lax979537.StructureEncoding.encodeLength

-/

name: Lax979537Proofs.StructureEncoding.encodeLength
statement:
theorem encodeLength {σ : Vocabulary} {k : Nat} (A : PointedStructure σ k) :
    (encode A).length = A.structureValue.size + 1 +
      (σ.map (fun r => A.structureValue.size ^ r)).sum +
      ((List.finRange k).map (fun i => (A.tuple i).val + 1)).sum
proof:
:= by
  simp only [encode, List.length_append, unary_length, List.length_flatMap,
    List.length_map, tuples_length, map_get_finRange]

/

name: Lax979537Proofs.StructureEncoding.unary_append_inj
statement:
theorem unary_append_inj (n m : Nat) (xs ys : List Bool)
    (h : unary n ++ xs = unary m ++ ys) : n = m ∧ xs = ys
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing m with
  | zero =>
      cases m with
      | zero => simpa [unary] using h
      | succ m => simp [unary, List.replicate_succ] at h
  | succ n ih =>
      cases m with
      | zero => simp [unary, List.replicate_succ] at h
      | succ m =>
          have h' : unary n ++ xs = unary m ++ ys := by
            simpa [unary, List.replicate_succ] using h
          obtain ⟨hn, ht⟩ := ih m h'
          exact ⟨congrArg Nat.succ hn, ht⟩

/

name: Lax979537Proofs.StructureEncoding.blocks_append_inj
statement:
theorem blocks_append_inj {ι : Type} (is : List ι) (f g : ι → List Bool)
    (xs ys : List Bool) (hlen : ∀ i ∈ is, (f i).length = (g i).length)
    (h : is.flatMap f ++ xs = is.flatMap g ++ ys) :
    (∀ i ∈ is, f i = g i) ∧ xs = ys
proof:
:= by
  induction is with
  | nil => simpa using h
  | cons i is ih =>
      simp only [List.flatMap_cons, List.append_assoc] at h
      obtain ⟨hi, ht⟩ := List.append_inj h (hlen i (by simp))
      obtain ⟨hrest, htail⟩ := ih (fun j hj => hlen j (by simp [hj])) ht
      refine ⟨?_, htail⟩
      intro j hj
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hj with rfl | hj
      · exact hi
      · exact hrest j hj

name: Lax979537Proofs.StructureEncoding.unary_blocks_inj
statement:
theorem unary_blocks_inj {ι : Type} (is : List ι) (f g : ι → Nat)
    (h : is.flatMap (fun i => unary (f i)) =
      is.flatMap (fun i => unary (g i))) : ∀ i ∈ is, f i = g i
proof:
:= by
  induction is with
  | nil => simp
  | cons i is ih =>
      obtain ⟨hi, ht⟩ := unary_append_inj (f i) (g i) _ _ h
      intro j hj
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hj with rfl | hj
      · exact hi
      · exact ih ht j hj

/

conclusion: Lax979537.StructureEncoding.encodeInjective

-/

name: Lax979537Proofs.StructureEncoding.encodeInjective
statement:
theorem encodeInjective (σ : Vocabulary) (k : Nat) :
    Function.Injective (@encode σ k)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨⟨n, R⟩, a⟩ ⟨⟨m, S⟩, b⟩ h
  change (unary n ++ _) ++ _ = (unary m ++ _) ++ _ at h
  rw [List.append_assoc, List.append_assoc] at h
  obtain ⟨hn, hrest⟩ := unary_append_inj n m _ _ h
  cases hn
  obtain ⟨hR, ha⟩ := blocks_append_inj (List.finRange σ.length)
    (fun r => (tuples n (σ.get r)).map (R r))
    (fun r => (tuples n (σ.get r)).map (S r)) _ _ (by simp) hrest
  have hRS : R = S := by
    funext r t
    exact List.map_inj_left.mp (hR r (by simp)) t (mem_tuples _ _ t)
  cases hRS
  have hab : a = b := by
    funext i
    apply Fin.ext
    exact unary_blocks_inj (List.finRange k) (fun i => (a i).val)
      (fun i => (b i).val) ha i (by simp)
  cases hab
  rfl

name: Lax979537Proofs.SupportedCodes.tag_of_mem
statement: theorem tag_of_mem {a : α} (ha : a ∈ S) : tag S a = finiteTag (⟨a, ha⟩ : ↥S) + 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [tag, ha]

name: Lax979537Proofs.SupportedCodes.tag_bound
statement: theorem tag_bound (a : α) : tag S a < S.card + 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases ha : a ∈ S
  · rw [tag_of_mem S ha]
    have h := finiteTag_lt (⟨a, ha⟩ : ↥S)
    simpa using Nat.succ_lt_succ h
  · simp [tag, ha]

name: Lax979537Proofs.SupportedCodes.tag_injective
statement: theorem tag_injective {a b : α} (ha : a ∈ S) (hb : b ∈ S) (he : tag S a = tag S b) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  rw [tag_of_mem S ha, tag_of_mem S hb] at he
  have hs := finiteTag_injective (Nat.add_right_cancel he)
  exact congrArg Subtype.val hs

/
the code is injective on the proved finite support set. -/

name: Lax979537Proofs.SupportedCodes.code_injective
statement:
theorem code_injective {n : Nat} (hn : S.card + 1 ≤ n)
    {a b : α} (ha : a ∈ S) (hb : b ∈ S) (he : code S hn a = code S hn b) : a = b
proof:
:=
  tag_injective S ha hb (congrArg (fun x : Fin n => x.val) he)

/
needed when the distinguished accepting output symbol is never produced. -/

name: Lax979537Proofs.SupportedCodes.code_eq_iff
statement:
theorem code_eq_iff {n : Nat} (hn : S.card + 1 ≤ n) {a b : α} (ha : a ∈ S) :
    code S hn a = code S hn b ↔ a = b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro he
    by_cases hb : b ∈ S
    · exact code_injective S hn ha hb he
    · have ht := congrArg (fun x : Fin n => x.val) he
      change tag S a = tag S b at ht
      rw [tag_of_mem S ha] at ht
      simp [tag, hb] at ht
  · rintro rfl; rfl

name: Lax979537Proofs.SyntaxOperations.rename_positiveAt
statement:
theorem rename_positiveAt {σ : Vocabulary} {m : Nat} {ρ : List Nat}
    (φ : RawFormula σ m ρ) {l : Nat} (f : Fin m → Fin l)
    (r : Fin ρ.length) (p : Bool) :
    (rename φ f).positiveAt r p ↔ φ.positiveAt r p
proof:
:= by
  induction φ generalizing l p with
  | truth | equal | less | relation | «variable» => rfl
  | neg ψ ih => exact ih _ r (!p)
  | conj ψ χ ihψ ihχ => exact and_congr (ihψ _ r p) (ihχ _ r p)
  | exists' ψ ih => exact ih _ r p
  | lfp k body args ih => exact ih _ r.succ p

name: Lax979537Proofs.SyntaxOperations.rename_admissible
proof:
:= by
  induction φ generalizing l with
  | truth | equal | less | relation | «variable» => rfl
  | neg ψ ih => exact ih _
  | conj ψ χ ihψ ihχ => exact and_congr (ihψ _) (ihχ _)
  | exists' ψ ih => exact ih _
  | lfp k body args ih =>
      exact and_congr (ih _) (rename_positiveAt body _ 0 true)

name: Lax979537Proofs.SyntaxOperations.cons_comp_liftOne
statement:
theorem cons_comp_liftOne {α : Type} {m l : Nat} (a : α) (v : Fin l → α)
    (f : Fin m → Fin l) :
    Fin.cons a v ∘ liftOne f = Fin.cons a (v ∘ f)
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  exact Fin.cases rfl (fun _ => rfl) x

name: Lax979537Proofs.SyntaxOperations.append_comp_liftBlock
statement:
theorem append_comp_liftBlock {α : Type} {m l k : Nat} (a : Fin k → α)
    (v : Fin l → α) (f : Fin m → Fin l) :
    Fin.append a v ∘ liftBlock k f = Fin.append a (v ∘ f)
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ x
  · intro i
    simp [Function.comp_def, liftBlock, Fin.append]
  · intro i
    simp [Function.comp_def, liftBlock, Fin.append]

name: Lax979537Proofs.SyntaxOperations.eval_rename
statement:
theorem eval_rename {σ : Vocabulary} {m : Nat} {ρ : List Nat}
    (φ : RawFormula σ m ρ) (A : OrderedStructure σ)
    {l : Nat} (f : Fin m → Fin l) (v : Fin l → Fin A.size)
    (η : RelationEnv A.size ρ) :
    eval (rename φ f) A v η ↔ eval φ A (v ∘ f) η
proof:
:= by
  induction φ generalizing l with
  | truth | equal | less | relation | «variable» => rfl
  | neg ψ ih => exact not_congr (ih f v η)
  | conj ψ χ ihψ ihχ => exact and_congr (ihψ f v η) (ihχ f v η)
  | exists' ψ ih =>
      apply exists_congr
      intro a
      simpa only [cons_comp_liftOne] using ih (liftOne f) (Fin.cons a v) η
  | lfp k body args ih =>
      have hF : (fun R => {a | eval (rename body (liftBlock k f)) A
          (Fin.append a v) (extend R η)}) =
          (fun R => {a | eval body A (Fin.append a (v ∘ f)) (extend R η)}) := by
        funext R
        apply Set.ext
        intro a
        simpa only [append_comp_liftBlock] using
          ih (liftBlock k f) (Fin.append a v) (extend R η)
      change Lax979537.LeastFixedPoints.leastFixedPoint _ (v ∘ (f ∘ args)) ↔
        Lax979537.LeastFixedPoints.leastFixedPoint _ ((v ∘ f) ∘ args)
      rw [hF]
      rfl

name: Lax979537Proofs.TM2Alphabet.supports_symbols
statement:
theorem supports_symbols [Fintype State] (q : TM2.Stmt Γ Λ State) (S : Set (Sigma Γ))
    (hS : ∀ a ∈ symbols q, a ∈ S) : Supports S q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction q with
  | push k f q ih =>
      exact ⟨fun v => hS _ (by simp [symbols]), ih (fun a ha => hS a (by simp [symbols, ha]))⟩
  | peek k f q ih | pop k f q ih | load f q ih => exact ih hS
  | branch f p q ihp ihq =>
      exact ⟨ihp (fun a ha => hS a (by simp [symbols, ha])), ihq (fun a ha => hS a (by simp [symbols, ha]))⟩
  | goto f | halt => trivial

name: Lax979537Proofs.TM2Alphabet.supports_substatement
statement:
theorem supports_substatement {S : Set (Sigma Γ)} {p q : TM2.Stmt Γ Λ State}
    (hp : p ∈ TM2.stmts₁ q) (hq : Supports S q) : Supports S p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction q with
  | push k f q ih =>
      simp only [TM2.stmts₁, Finset.mem_insert] at hp
      rcases hp with rfl | hp
      · exact hq
      · exact ih hp hq.2
  | peek k f q ih | pop k f q ih | load f q ih =>
      simp only [TM2.stmts₁, Finset.mem_insert] at hp
      rcases hp with rfl | hp
      · exact hq
      · exact ih hp hq
  | branch f q r ihq ihr =>
      simp only [TM2.stmts₁, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_union] at hp
      rcases hp with rfl | hp | hp
      · exact hq
      · exact ihq hp hq.1
      · exact ihr hp hq.2
  | goto f | halt =>
      simp only [TM2.stmts₁, Finset.mem_singleton] at hp
      subst p
      exact hq

name: Lax979537Proofs.TM2Alphabet.stepAux_valid
statement:
theorem stepAux_valid [DecidableEq K] (S : Set (Sigma Γ)) (q : TM2.Stmt Γ Λ State)
    (hq : Supports S q) (v : State) (stk : (k : K) → List (Γ k)) (hs : Valid S stk) :
    Valid S (TM2.stepAux q v stk).stk
proof:
:= by
  induction q generalizing v stk with
  | push k f q ih =>
      apply ih hq.2
      intro j a ha
      by_cases hj : j = k
      · subst j
        simp only [Function.update_self, List.mem_cons] at ha
        rcases ha with rfl | ha
        · exact hq.1 v
        · exact hs k a ha
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne hj] at ha
        exact hs j a ha
  | peek k f q ih | load f q ih => exact ih hq _ _ hs
  | pop k f q ih =>
      apply ih hq
      intro j a ha
      by_cases hj : j = k
      · subst j
        rw [Function.update_self] at ha
        exact hs k a (List.mem_of_mem_tail ha)
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne hj] at ha
        exact hs j a ha
  | branch f p q ihp ihq =>
      cases hf : f v <;> simp only [TM2.stepAux, hf, cond_false, cond_true]
      · exact ihq hq.2 _ _ hs
      · exact ihp hq.1 _ _ hs
  | goto f | halt => exact hs

name: Lax979537Proofs.TM2Alphabet.machine_supports
statement: theorem machine_supports (tm : FinTM2) (l : tm.Λ) : Supports (alphabet tm : Set (Sigma tm.Γ)) (tm.m l)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI := tm.σFin
  letI := tm.Γk₀Fin
  letI := tm.ΛFin
  apply supports_symbols
  intro a ha
  simp only [Finset.mem_coe, alphabet, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  exact Or.inr ⟨l, ha⟩

name: Lax979537Proofs.TM2Alphabet.initial_valid
statement:
theorem initial_valid (tm : FinTM2) (xs : List (tm.Γ tm.k₀)) :
    Valid (alphabet tm : Set (Sigma tm.Γ)) (initList tm xs).stk
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro k a ha
  by_cases hk : k = tm.k₀
  · subst k
    simp [alphabet]
  · simp [initList, hk] at ha

name: Lax979537Proofs.TM2Alphabet.step_valid
statement:
theorem step_valid (tm : FinTM2) {c d : tm.Cfg} (h : tm.step c = some d)
    (hc : Valid (alphabet tm : Set (Sigma tm.Γ)) c.stk) :
    Valid (alphabet tm : Set (Sigma tm.Γ)) d.stk
proof:
:= by
  cases c with
  | mk l v stk =>
      cases l with
      | none => simp [FinTM2.step, TM2.step] at h
      | some l =>
          have he : TM2.stepAux (tm.m l) v stk = d := Option.some.inj h
          rw [← he]
          exact stepAux_valid _ _ (machine_supports tm l) v stk hc

name: Lax979537Proofs.TM2Alphabet.iterate_valid
statement:
theorem iterate_valid (tm : FinTM2) (n : Nat) {c d : tm.Cfg}
    (hc : Valid (alphabet tm : Set (Sigma tm.Γ)) c.stk)
    (h : (fun q : Option tm.Cfg => q.bind tm.step)^[n] (some c) = some d) :
    Valid (alphabet tm : Set (Sigma tm.Γ)) d.stk
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing d with
  | zero =>
      have he : c = d := Option.some.inj h
      exact he ▸ hc
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply'] at h
      cases hr : (fun q : Option tm.Cfg => q.bind tm.step)^[n] (some c) with
      | none => simp only [hr, Option.bind_none, reduceCtorEq] at h
      | some e =>
          have hs : tm.step e = some d := by simpa only [hr, Option.bind_some] using h
          exact step_valid tm hs (ih hr)

name: Lax979537Proofs.TM2Alphabet.evals_valid
proof:
:=
  iterate_valid tm h.steps (initial_valid tm xs) h.evals_in_steps

/

name: Lax979537Proofs.TM2Micro.statement_refines
statement:
theorem statement_refines (M : Λ → TM2.Stmt Γ Λ State) (q : TM2.Stmt Γ Λ State)
    (v : State) (stk : (k : K) → List (Γ k)) :
    ∃ t, t ≤ weight q ∧ (next M)^[t] (instruction q v stk) = boundary (TM2.stepAux q v stk)
proof:
:= by
  induction q generalizing v stk with
  | push k f q ih | pop k f q ih | peek k f q ih | load f q ih =>
      obtain ⟨t, ht, hp⟩ := ih _ _
      exact ⟨t + 1, Nat.add_le_add_right ht 1, by simpa only [Function.iterate_succ_apply, next, instruction, TM2.stepAux] using hp⟩
  | branch f p q ihp ihq =>
      cases hf : f v with
      | false =>
          obtain ⟨t, ht, hp⟩ := ihq v stk
          refine ⟨t + 1, Nat.add_le_add_right (ht.trans (Nat.le_max_right _ _)) 1, ?_⟩
          simpa [Function.iterate_succ_apply, next, instruction, TM2.stepAux, hf] using hp
      | true =>
          obtain ⟨t, ht, hp⟩ := ihp v stk
          refine ⟨t + 1, Nat.add_le_add_right (ht.trans (Nat.le_max_left _ _)) 1, ?_⟩
          simpa [Function.iterate_succ_apply, next, instruction, TM2.stepAux, hf] using hp
  | goto f | halt => exact ⟨1, le_rfl, rfl⟩

name: Lax979537Proofs.TM2Micro.macro_refines
statement:
theorem macro_refines (M : Λ → TM2.Stmt Γ Λ State) (C : Nat)
    (hC : ∀ l, weight (M l) + 1 ≤ C) (c : TM2.Cfg Γ Λ State) :
    ∃ t, t ≤ C ∧ (next M)^[t] (boundary c) = boundary (macroNext M c)
proof:
:= by
  cases c with
  | mk l v stk =>
      cases l with
      | none => exact ⟨0, Nat.zero_le _, rfl⟩
      | some l =>
          obtain ⟨t, ht, hp⟩ := statement_refines M (M l) v stk
          refine ⟨t + 1, (Nat.add_le_add_right ht 1).trans (hC l), ?_⟩
          simpa only [Function.iterate_succ_apply, next, boundary, macroNext, TM2.step, Option.getD_some] using hp

name: Lax979537Proofs.TM2Micro.iterate_refines
statement:
theorem iterate_refines (M : Λ → TM2.Stmt Γ Λ State) (C : Nat)
    (hC : ∀ l, weight (M l) + 1 ≤ C) (n : Nat) (c : TM2.Cfg Γ Λ State) :
    ∃ t, t ≤ C * n ∧ (next M)^[t] (boundary c) = boundary ((macroNext M)^[n] c)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, by simp, rfl⟩
  | succ n ih =>
      obtain ⟨t, ht, hp⟩ := ih
      obtain ⟨u, hu, hq⟩ := macro_refines M C hC ((macroNext M)^[n] c)
      refine ⟨u + t, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [Nat.mul_succ]; omega
      · rw [Function.iterate_add_apply, hp, hq, Function.iterate_succ_apply']

name: Lax979537Proofs.TM2Micro.weight_le_factor
statement: theorem weight_le_factor (tm : FinTM2) (l : tm.Λ) : weight (tm.m l) + 1 ≤ factor tm
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI := tm.ΛFin
  change weight (tm.m l) + 1 ≤ (Finset.univ.sum fun j : tm.Λ => weight (tm.m j)) + 1
  exact Nat.add_le_add_right
    (Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => Nat.zero_le (weight (tm.m j))) (Finset.mem_univ l)) 1

name: Lax979537Proofs.TM2Micro.finite_iterate_refines
statement:
theorem finite_iterate_refines (tm : FinTM2) (n : Nat) (c : tm.Cfg) :
    ∃ t, t ≤ factor tm * n ∧
      (next tm.m)^[t] (boundary c) = boundary ((macroNext tm.m)^[n] c)
proof:
:=
  iterate_refines tm.m (factor tm) (weight_le_factor tm) n c

name: Lax979537Proofs.TM2Micro.macro_matches
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing c with
  | zero => exact Option.some.inj h
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply] at h ⊢
      cases hs : TM2.step M c with
      | none =>
          have hn : (fun q : Option (TM2.Cfg Γ Λ State) => q.bind (TM2.step M))^[n] none = none :=
            Function.iterate_fixed rfl n
          simp only [Option.bind_some, hs, hn, reduceCtorEq] at h
      | some e =>
          have he : (fun q : Option (TM2.Cfg Γ Λ State) => q.bind (TM2.step M))^[n] (some e) = some d := by
            simpa only [Option.bind_some, hs] using h
          simpa only [macroNext, hs, Option.getD_some] using ih he

/
overhead. No step-count composition assertion is assumed. -/

name: Lax979537Proofs.TM2Micro.evals_refines
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hp⟩ := finite_iterate_refines tm h.steps c
  rw [macro_matches tm.m h.steps h.evals_in_steps] at hp
  exact ⟨t, ht.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ h.steps_le_m), hp⟩

name: Lax979537Proofs.TM2Micro.halt_fixed
statement:
theorem halt_fixed (M : Λ → TM2.Stmt Γ Λ State) (c : TM2.Cfg Γ Λ State) (hc : c.l = none) :
    next M (boundary c) = boundary c
proof:
:= by
  simp [next, boundary, hc]

/
terminal configuration. This permits a coarse tuple-sized time horizon. -/

name: Lax979537Proofs.TM2Micro.evals_at_time
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hp⟩ := evals_refines tm h
  have htn : t ≤ N := ht.trans hN
  rw [show N = (N - t) + t from (Nat.sub_add_cancel htn).symm,
    Function.iterate_add_apply, hp]
  exact Function.iterate_fixed (halt_fixed tm.m d hd) _

name: Lax979537Proofs.TM2MicroSupport.boundary_mem
statement: theorem boundary_mem (tm : FinTM2) (l : Option tm.Λ) : Cursor.boundary l ∈ controls tm
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [controls]

name: Lax979537Proofs.TM2MicroSupport.instruction_mem
statement:
theorem instruction_mem (tm : FinTM2) (q : TM2.Stmt tm.Γ tm.Λ tm.σ) :
    Cursor.instruction q ∈ controls tm ↔ ∃ l, q ∈ TM2.stmts₁ (tm.m l)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [controls]

name: Lax979537Proofs.TM2MicroSupport.instruction_sub
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := (instruction_mem tm q).mp hq
  exact (instruction_mem tm p).mpr ⟨l, TM2.stmts₁_trans hl hp⟩

name: Lax979537Proofs.TM2MicroSupport.next_control
statement:
theorem next_control (tm : FinTM2) (c : Cfg tm.Γ tm.Λ tm.σ) (hc : c.cursor ∈ controls tm) :
    (next tm.m c).cursor ∈ controls tm
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases c with
  | mk cursor v stk =>
      cases cursor with
      | boundary l =>
          cases l with
          | none => exact hc
          | some l => exact (instruction_mem tm _).mpr ⟨l, TM2.stmts₁_self⟩
      | instruction q =>
          cases q with
          | push k f q | pop k f q | peek k f q | load f q =>
              apply instruction_sub tm hc
              simp [TM2.stmts₁, TM2.stmts₁_self]
          | branch f p q =>
              cases hf : f v <;> simp only [next, hf, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
              · apply instruction_sub tm hc
                simp [TM2.stmts₁, TM2.stmts₁_self]
              · apply instruction_sub tm hc
                simp [TM2.stmts₁, TM2.stmts₁_self]
          | goto f | halt => exact boundary_mem tm _

name: Lax979537Proofs.TM2MicroSupport.next_alphabet
statement:
theorem next_alphabet (tm : FinTM2) (c : Cfg tm.Γ tm.Λ tm.σ)
    (hc : c.cursor ∈ controls tm) (hs : TM2Alphabet.Valid (TM2Alphabet.alphabet tm : Set (Sigma tm.Γ)) c.stk) :
    TM2Alphabet.Valid (TM2Alphabet.alphabet tm : Set (Sigma tm.Γ)) (next tm.m c).stk
proof:
:= by
  cases c with
  | mk cursor v stk =>
      cases cursor with
      | boundary l => cases l <;> exact hs
      | instruction q =>
          obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := (instruction_mem tm q).mp hc
          have hq := TM2Alphabet.supports_substatement hl (TM2Alphabet.machine_supports tm l)
          cases q with
          | push k f q =>
              intro j a ha
              by_cases hj : j = k
              · subst j
                simp only [next, instruction, Function.update_self, List.mem_cons] at ha
                rcases ha with rfl | ha
                · exact hq.1 v
                · exact hs k a ha
              · simp only [next, instruction, Function.update_of_ne hj] at ha
                exact hs j a ha
          | pop k f q =>
              intro j a ha
              by_cases hj : j = k
              · subst j
                simp only [next, instruction, Function.update_self] at ha
                exact hs k a (List.mem_of_mem_tail ha)
              · simp only [next, instruction, Function.update_of_ne hj] at ha
                exact hs j a ha
          | branch f p q => cases hf : f v <;> exact hs
          | peek k f q | load f q | goto f | halt => exact hs

name: Lax979537Proofs.TM2MicroSupport.iterate_support
statement:
theorem iterate_support (tm : FinTM2) (n : Nat) (c : Cfg tm.Γ tm.Λ tm.σ)
    (hc : c.cursor ∈ controls tm) (hs : TM2Alphabet.Valid (TM2Alphabet.alphabet tm : Set (Sigma tm.Γ)) c.stk) :
    ((next tm.m)^[n] c).cursor ∈ controls tm ∧
      TM2Alphabet.Valid (TM2Alphabet.alphabet tm : Set (Sigma tm.Γ)) ((next tm.m)^[n] c).stk
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact ⟨hc, hs⟩
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
      exact ⟨next_control tm _ ih.1, next_alphabet tm _ ih.1 ih.2⟩

name: Lax979537Proofs.TM2MicroSupport.initial_run_support
statement:
theorem initial_run_support (tm : FinTM2) (xs : List (tm.Γ tm.k₀)) (n : Nat) :
    ((next tm.m)^[n] (boundary (initList tm xs))).cursor ∈ controls tm ∧
      TM2Alphabet.Valid (TM2Alphabet.alphabet tm : Set (Sigma tm.Γ))
        ((next tm.m)^[n] (boundary (initList tm xs))).stk
proof:
:=
  iterate_support tm n _ (boundary_mem tm _) (TM2Alphabet.initial_valid tm xs)

name: Lax979537Proofs.TM2MicroSupport.length_next
statement:
theorem length_next (tm : FinTM2) (c : Cfg tm.Γ tm.Λ tm.σ) (key : tm.K) :
    ((next tm.m c).stk key).length ≤ (c.stk key).length + 1
proof:
:= by
  cases c with
  | mk cursor v stk =>
      cases cursor with
      | boundary l => cases l <;> simp [next, instruction]
      | instruction q =>
          cases q with
          | push k f q =>
              by_cases hk : key = k
              · subst key; simp [next, instruction]
              · simp [next, instruction, hk]
          | pop k f q =>
              by_cases hk : key = k
              · subst key; simp [next, instruction]; omega
              · simp [next, instruction, hk]
          | branch f p q => simp [next, instruction]
          | peek k f q | load f q | goto f | halt => simp [next, instruction]

name: Lax979537Proofs.TM2MicroSupport.length_iterate
statement:
theorem length_iterate (tm : FinTM2) (n : Nat) (c : Cfg tm.Γ tm.Λ tm.σ) (key : tm.K) :
    (((next tm.m)^[n] c).stk key).length ≤ (c.stk key).length + n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
      have h := length_next tm ((next tm.m)^[n] c) key
      omega

name: Lax979537Proofs.TM2MicroSupport.initial_length
statement:
theorem initial_length (tm : FinTM2) (xs : List (tm.Γ tm.k₀)) (n : Nat) (key : tm.K) :
    (((next tm.m)^[n] (boundary (initList tm xs))).stk key).length ≤ xs.length + n
proof:
:= by
  have h := length_iterate tm n (boundary (initList tm xs)) key
  have hi : ((initList tm xs).stk key).length ≤ xs.length := by
    by_cases hk : key = tm.k₀
    · subst key; simp [initList]
    · simp [initList, hk]
  exact h.trans (Nat.add_le_add_right hi n)

name: Lax979537Proofs.TableEvaluation.denote_cons
statement:
theorem denote_cons {n k : Nat} {ρ : List Nat} (R : Table n k)
    (η : TableEnv n ρ) :
    denote (Fin.cons R η) = extend {a | a ∈ R} (denote η)
proof:
:= by
  funext r
  exact Fin.cases rfl (fun _ => rfl) r

name: Lax979537Proofs.TableEvaluation.rounds_correct
statement:
theorem rounds_correct {α : Type} (next : List α → List α)
    (F : Set α → Set α)
    (h : ∀ R, {a | a ∈ next R} = F {a | a ∈ R}) (t : Nat) :
    {a | a ∈ rounds next t} = stage F t
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => simp [rounds, stage]
  | succ t ih => rw [rounds, h, ih, stage]

name: Lax979537Proofs.TableEvaluation.evaluate_correct
statement:
theorem evaluate_correct {σ : Vocabulary} {m : Nat} {ρ : List Nat}
    (φ : RawFormula σ m ρ) (hφ : φ.Admissible) (A : OrderedStructure σ)
    (v : Fin m → Fin A.size) (η : TableEnv A.size ρ) :
    evaluate φ A v η = true ↔ eval φ A v (denote η)
proof:
:= by
  induction φ with
  | truth => simp [evaluate, eval]
  | equal x y => simp [evaluate, eval]
  | less x y => simp [evaluate, eval]
  | relation r args => rfl
  | «variable» r args =>
      simp only [evaluate, eval, denote, decide_eq_true_eq]
      rfl
  | neg ψ ih => simpa [evaluate, eval] using not_congr (ih hφ v η)
  | conj ψ χ ihψ ihχ =>
      simp only [evaluate, Bool.and_eq_true, eval]
      exact and_congr (ihψ hφ.1 v η) (ihχ hφ.2 v η)
  | exists' ψ ih =>
      simp only [evaluate, List.any_eq_true, List.mem_finRange, true_and, eval]
      exact exists_congr (fun a => ih hφ (Fin.cons a v) η)
  | lfp k body args ih =>
      let next := fun R => (tuples A.size k).filter fun a =>
        evaluate body A (Fin.append a v) (Fin.cons R η)
      let F := bodyOperator body A v (denote η)
      have hnext : ∀ R, {a | a ∈ next R} = F {a | a ∈ R} := by
        intro R
        apply Set.ext
        intro a
        simp only [next, List.mem_filter, StructureEncoding.mem_tuples, true_and]
        change evaluate body A (Fin.append a v) (Fin.cons R η) = true ↔
          eval body A (Fin.append a v) (extend {a | a ∈ R} (denote η))
        exact (ih hφ.1 (Fin.append a v) (Fin.cons R η)).trans
          (iff_of_eq (congrArg (eval body A (Fin.append a v)) (denote_cons R η)))
      have hrounds : {a | a ∈ rounds next (A.size ^ k)} = leastFixedPoint F := by
        rw [rounds_correct next F hnext]
        have hmono := Positivity.positiveBodyMonotone body hφ.1 hφ.2 A v (denote η)
        simpa only [Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin] using
          LeastFixedPoints.finiteConvergence F hmono
      change decide ((v ∘ args) ∈ rounds next (A.size ^ k)) = true ↔
        (v ∘ args) ∈ leastFixedPoint F
      rw [decide_eq_true_eq, ← hrounds]
      rfl

name: Lax979537Proofs.TimedNodes.bounded_mono
statement:
theorem bounded_mono {H : Records (Node Initial) Γ} {t u : Nat} (h : Bounded H t) (htu : t ≤ u) :
    Bounded H u
proof:
:= by
  intro n a p hn
  have hb := h n a p hn
  cases n with
  | inl i => trivial
  | inr v => exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hb htu

name: Lax979537Proofs.TimedNodes.bounded_fresh
statement: theorem bounded_fresh {H : Records (Node Initial) Γ} {t : Nat} (h : Bounded H t) : Fresh H (.inr t)
proof:
:= by
  intro a p hm
  exact Nat.lt_irrefl t (h (.inr t) a p hm)

name: Lax979537Proofs.TimedNodes.step_bounded
proof:
:= by
  have hm := bounded_mono hH (Nat.le_succ t)
  cases h with
  | push k f q v heads =>
      intro n a p hn
      rcases Set.mem_insert_iff.mp hn with he | hn
      · cases he; exact Nat.lt_succ_self t
      · exact hm n a p hn
  | stopped | enter | pop | peek | load | branch | goto | halt => exact hm

/

name: Lax979537Proofs.TimedNodes.run_sound
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | zero => exact ⟨hF, hB, hM⟩
  | @succ t H c G d hr hs ih =>
      obtain ⟨hG, hmatch⟩ := step_sound hs ih.1 (bounded_fresh ih.2.1)
        ((TM2Micro.next M)^[t] d₀).stk ih.2.2.2.2
      rw [ih.2.2.expand_eq] at hmatch
      refine ⟨hG, step_bounded hs ih.2.1, ?_⟩
      simpa only [Function.iterate_succ_apply'] using hmatch

name: Lax979537Proofs.TimedNodes.run_exists
statement:
theorem run_exists (M : Λ → TM2.Stmt Γ Λ State) (H₀ : Records (Node Initial) Γ)
    (c₀ : NodeMachine.Cfg Γ Λ State (Node Initial)) (hF : Functional H₀) (hB : Bounded H₀ 0)
    (d₀ : TM2Micro.Cfg Γ Λ State) (hM : Matches H₀ c₀ d₀) (t : Nat) :
    ∃ H c, Run M H₀ c₀ t H c
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => exact ⟨H₀, c₀, .zero⟩
  | succ t ih =>
      obtain ⟨H, c, hr⟩ := ih
      have hmatch := (run_sound hr hF hB d₀ hM).2.2
      obtain ⟨G, d, hs⟩ := step_exists M (.inr t) H c ((TM2Micro.next M)^[t] d₀).stk hmatch.2.2
      exact ⟨G, d, .succ hr hs⟩

name: Lax979537Proofs.TimedNodes.run_unique
proof:
:= by
  induction hc generalizing G d with
  | zero => cases hd; exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  | @succ t H c J e hr hs ih =>
      cases hd with
      | succ hr' hs' =>
          obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := ih hr'
          exact step_unique (run_sound hr hF hB d₀ hM).1 hs hs'

name: Lax979537Proofs.TraceCodes.closure_valid
statement:
theorem closure_valid (fact : Fact h.tm.Γ h.tm.Λ h.tm.σ (Identifier σ m A.structureValue.size))
    (hf : fact ∈ closure (SimulationHorizon.context h A) (A.structureValue.size ^ d - 1)) :
    FactSupport.Valid h.tm (A.structureValue.size ^ d) fact
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < A.structureValue.size := by unfold threshold at hn; omega
  have he : A.structureValue.size ^ d - 1 + 1 = A.structureValue.size ^ d :=
    Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Nat.pow_pos hpos))
  have hv := FactSupport.closure_valid h.tm (InitialInput.raw h.tm h.inputAlphabet A)
    (InitialInput.names h.tm h.inputAlphabet A) (InitialInput.names_injective h.tm h.inputAlphabet A)
    (A.structureValue.size ^ d - 1) fact hf
  simpa only [he] using hv

/
bounded run, without an injectivity assumption on the unbounded raw type. -/

name: Lax979537Proofs.TraceCodes.code_injective_on_closure
statement:
theorem code_injective_on_closure
    {p q : Fact h.tm.Γ h.tm.Λ h.tm.σ (Identifier σ m A.structureValue.size)}
    (hp : p ∈ closure (SimulationHorizon.context h A) (A.structureValue.size ^ d - 1))
    (hq : q ∈ closure (SimulationHorizon.context h A) (A.structureValue.size ^ d - 1))
    (he : code h.tm d A hn p = code h.tm d A hn q) : p = q
proof:
:=
  FactCodes.code_injective (parameters h.tm d A hn)
    (closure_valid h d A hn p hp) (closure_valid h d A hn q hq) he

name: Lax979537Proofs.TraceCodes.mem_encoded_iff
statement:
theorem mem_encoded_iff
    (p : Fact h.tm.Γ h.tm.Λ h.tm.σ (Identifier σ m A.structureValue.size))
    (hp : FactSupport.Valid h.tm (A.structureValue.size ^ d) p) :
    code h.tm d A hn p ∈ encoded h d A hn ↔
      p ∈ closure (SimulationHorizon.context h A) (A.structureValue.size ^ d - 1)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q, hq, he⟩
    have hqp := FactCodes.code_injective (parameters h.tm d A hn)
      (closure_valid h d A hn q hq) hp he
    exact hqp ▸ hq
  · intro hp; exact ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩

name: Lax979537Proofs.TransitionClosure.at_time
statement:
theorem at_time
    (R : Set (Fin (TraceCodes.arity h.tm σ d) → Fin A.structureValue.size))
    (hclosed : ParameterizedRules.operator (TransitionRules.rules h.tm σ m d (TraceCodes.nodeWidth σ d))
      A.structureValue A.tuple R ⊆ R)
    (hinit : TraceCodes.code h.tm d A hn (.config 0 (SimulationHorizon.context h A).config) ∈ R)
    (hnodes : ∀ r ∈ (SimulationHorizon.context h A).heap, TraceCodes.code h.tm d A hn (.node r) ∈ R)
    (t : Nat) (ht : t < A.structureValue.size ^ d) :
    TraceCodes.code h.tm d A hn (.config t (snapshot (SimulationHorizon.context h A) t).2) ∈ R ∧
      ∀ r ∈ (snapshot (SimulationHorizon.context h A) t).1, TraceCodes.code h.tm d A hn (.node r) ∈ R
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero =>
      rw [snapshot_zero]
      exact ⟨hinit, hnodes⟩
  | succ t ih =>
      obtain ⟨hcfg, hheap⟩ := ih (by omega)
      have hsem := trace_in_closure (SimulationHorizon.context h A) (A.structureValue.size ^ d - 1) t (by omega)
      have hvalid := TraceCodes.closure_valid h d A hn _ hsem.1
      have hsupport : ∀ r ∈ (snapshot (SimulationHorizon.context h A) t).1, r.2.1 ∈ TM2Alphabet.alphabet h.tm :=
        fun r hr => (TraceCodes.closure_valid h d A hn (.node r) (hsem.2 hr)).2.1
      have hs := snapshot_step (SimulationHorizon.context h A) t
      constructor
      · exact hclosed (TransitionDerivation.step h d A hn hs hvalid.2.1 ht R hcfg hsupport hheap)
      · intro r hr
        rcases (NodeMachine.step_records hs r).mp hr with hold | hnew
        · exact hheap r hold
        · exact hclosed (TransitionDerivation.added h d A hn
            (snapshot (SimulationHorizon.context h A) t).2 r hnew hvalid.2.1 ht R hcfg)

/
compiler must prove the two seed hypotheses for its actual LFP. -/

name: Lax979537Proofs.TransitionClosure.encoded_subset
statement:
theorem encoded_subset
    (R : Set (Fin (TraceCodes.arity h.tm σ d) → Fin A.structureValue.size))
    (hclosed : ParameterizedRules.operator (TransitionRules.rules h.tm σ m d (TraceCodes.nodeWidth σ d))
      A.structureValue A.tuple R ⊆ R)
    (hinit : TraceCodes.code h.tm d A hn (.config 0 (SimulationHorizon.context h A).config) ∈ R)
    (hnodes : ∀ r ∈ (SimulationHorizon.context h A).heap, TraceCodes.code h.tm d A hn (.node r) ∈ R) :
    TraceCodes.encoded h d A hn ⊆ R
proof:
:= by
  have hnpos : 0 < A.structureValue.size := by unfold TraceCodes.threshold at hn; omega
  have hpow : 0 < A.structureValue.size ^ d := Nat.pow_pos hnpos
  rintro out ⟨fact, hf, rfl⟩
  rw [closure_eq_trace] at hf
  cases fact with
  | config t cfg =>
      rcases hf with ⟨ht, rfl⟩
      exact (at_time h d A hn R hclosed hinit hnodes t (by omega)).1
  | node r =>
      exact (at_time h d A hn R hclosed hinit hnodes (A.structureValue.size ^ d - 1) (by omega)).2 r hf

name: Lax979537Proofs.TransitionDerivation.step
statement:
theorem step {t : Nat}
    {H G : NodeMachine.Records (TimedNodes.Node (InputSegments.Identifier σ m A.structureValue.size)) h.tm.Γ}
    {cfg next : NodeMachine.Cfg h.tm.Γ h.tm.Λ h.tm.σ
      (TimedNodes.Node (InputSegments.Identifier σ m A.structureValue.size))}
    (hs : NodeMachine.Step h.tm.m (.inr t) H cfg G next)
    (hc : cfg.cursor ∈ TM2MicroSupport.controls h.tm)
    (ht : t + 1 < A.structureValue.size ^ d)
    (R : Set (Fin (TraceCodes.arity h.tm σ d) → Fin A.structureValue.size))
    (hp : TraceCodes.code h.tm d A hn (.config t cfg) ∈ R)
    (hsupport : ∀ r ∈ H, r.2.1 ∈ TM2Alphabet.alphabet h.tm)
    (hrecords : ∀ r ∈ H, TraceCodes.code h.tm d A hn (.node r) ∈ R) :
    TraceCodes.code h.tm d A hn (.config (t + 1) next) ∈
      ParameterizedRules.operator (TransitionRules.rules h.tm σ m d (TraceCodes.nodeWidth σ d))
        A.structureValue A.tuple R
proof:
:= by
  cases hs with
  | stopped v heads =>
      apply TransitionRules.plain h.tm A.structureValue A.tuple R
      exact PlainClosure.derives h d A hn ⟨.boundary none, v, heads⟩ (.boundary none) v rfl hc ht R hp
  | enter l v heads =>
      apply TransitionRules.plain h.tm A.structureValue A.tuple R
      exact PlainClosure.derives h d A hn ⟨.boundary (some l), v, heads⟩ (.instruction (h.tm.m l)) v rfl hc ht R hp
  | push k f q v heads =>
      apply TransitionRules.push h.tm false A.structureValue A.tuple R
      exact PushClosure.derives h d A hn ⟨.instruction (.push k f q), v, heads⟩
        ⟨k, f v, .instruction q⟩ false rfl hc ht R hp
  | pop k f q v heads a parent hr =>
      exact ReadDerivation.derives h d A hn H ⟨.instruction (.pop k f q), v, heads⟩
        ⟨k, f v, .instruction q, true⟩ a parent rfl hr hc ht R hp hsupport hrecords
  | peek k f q v heads a parent hr =>
      exact ReadDerivation.derives h d A hn H ⟨.instruction (.peek k f q), v, heads⟩
        ⟨k, f v, .instruction q, false⟩ a parent rfl hr hc ht R hp hsupport hrecords
  | load f q v heads =>
      apply TransitionRules.plain h.tm A.structureValue A.tuple R
      exact PlainClosure.derives h d A hn ⟨.instruction (.load f q), v, heads⟩ (.instruction q) (f v) rfl hc ht R hp
  | branch f p q v heads =>
      apply TransitionRules.plain h.tm A.structureValue A.tuple R
      exact PlainClosure.derives h d A hn ⟨.instruction (.branch f p q), v, heads⟩
        (.instruction (if f v then p else q)) v rfl hc ht R hp
  | goto f v heads =>
      apply TransitionRules.plain h.tm A.structureValue A.tuple R
      exact PlainClosure.derives h d A hn ⟨.instruction (.goto f), v, heads⟩ (.boundary (some (f v))) v rfl hc ht R hp
  | halt v heads =>
      apply TransitionRules.plain h.tm A.structureValue A.tuple R
      exact PlainClosure.derives h d A hn ⟨.instruction .halt, v, heads⟩ (.boundary none) v rfl hc ht R hp

/

name: Lax979537Proofs.TransitionDerivation.added
statement:
theorem added {t : Nat}
    (cfg : NodeMachine.Cfg h.tm.Γ h.tm.Λ h.tm.σ
      (TimedNodes.Node (InputSegments.Identifier σ m A.structureValue.size)))
    (r : TimedNodes.Node (InputSegments.Identifier σ m A.structureValue.size) × Sigma h.tm.Γ ×
      Option (TimedNodes.Node (InputSegments.Identifier σ m A.structureValue.size)))
    (ha : NodeMachine.added (.inr t) cfg = some r)
    (hc : cfg.cursor ∈ TM2MicroSupport.controls h.tm)
    (ht : t + 1 < A.structureValue.size ^ d)
    (R : Set (Fin (TraceCodes.arity h.tm σ d) → Fin A.structureValue.size))
    (hp : TraceCodes.code h.tm d A hn (.config t cfg) ∈ R) :
    TraceCodes.code h.tm d A hn (.node r) ∈
      ParameterizedRules.operator (TransitionRules.rules h.tm σ m d (TraceCodes.nodeWidth σ d))
        A.structureValue A.tuple R
proof:
:= by
  cases cfg with
  | mk c v heads =>
      cases c with
      | boundary l => cases ha
      | instruction q =>
          cases q with
          | push k f q =>
              cases ha
              apply TransitionRules.push h.tm true A.structureValue A.tuple R
              exact PushClosure.derives h d A hn ⟨.instruction (.push k f q), v, heads⟩
                ⟨k, f v, .instruction q⟩ true rfl hc ht R hp
          | pop | peek | load | branch | goto | halt => cases ha

name: Lax979537Proofs.TransitionRules.operator_iff
statement:
theorem operator_iff (tm : FinTM2) {σ : Vocabulary} {m d w : Nat}
    (A : OrderedStructure σ) (q : Fin m → Fin A.size)
    (R : Set (Fin (FactCodes.payloadWidth tm d w + 1) → Fin A.size))
    (out : Fin (FactCodes.payloadWidth tm d w + 1) → Fin A.size) :
    out ∈ ParameterizedRules.operator (rules tm σ m d w) A q R ↔
      out ∈ ParameterizedRules.operator (PlainControl.rules tm σ m d w) A q R ∨
      out ∈ ParameterizedRules.operator (PushRules.rules tm σ m d w false) A q R ∨
      out ∈ ParameterizedRules.operator (PushRules.rules tm σ m d w true) A q R ∨
      out ∈ ParameterizedRules.operator (EmptyReadRules.rules tm σ m d w) A q R ∨
      out ∈ ParameterizedRules.operator (NonemptyReadRules.rules tm σ m d w) A q R
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ParameterizedRules.operator, rules, Set.mem_setOf_eq, List.mem_append, or_and_right, exists_or]

name: Lax979537Proofs.TransitionRules.plain
statement:
theorem plain (tm : FinTM2) {σ : Vocabulary} {m d w : Nat}
    (A : OrderedStructure σ) (q : Fin m → Fin A.size) (R) :
    ParameterizedRules.operator (PlainControl.rules tm σ m d w) A q R ⊆
      ParameterizedRules.operator (rules tm σ m d w) A q R
proof:
:=
  fun out ho => (operator_iff tm A q R out).mpr (Or.inl ho)

name: Lax979537Proofs.TransitionRules.push
statement:
theorem push (tm : FinTM2) {σ : Vocabulary} {m d w : Nat} (emit : Bool)
    (A : OrderedStructure σ) (q : Fin m → Fin A.size) (R) :
    ParameterizedRules.operator (PushRules.rules tm σ m d w emit) A q R ⊆
      ParameterizedRules.operator (rules tm σ m d w) A q R
proof:
:= by
  intro out ho
  apply (operator_iff tm A q R out).mpr
  cases emit with
  | false => exact Or.inr (Or.inl ho)
  | true => exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ho))

name: Lax979537Proofs.TransitionRules.empty
statement:
theorem empty (tm : FinTM2) {σ : Vocabulary} {m d w : Nat}
    (A : OrderedStructure σ) (q : Fin m → Fin A.size) (R) :
    ParameterizedRules.operator (EmptyReadRules.rules tm σ m d w) A q R ⊆
      ParameterizedRules.operator (rules tm σ m d w) A q R
proof:
:=
  fun out ho => (operator_iff tm A q R out).mpr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ho))))

name: Lax979537Proofs.TransitionRules.nonempty
statement:
theorem nonempty (tm : FinTM2) {σ : Vocabulary} {m d w : Nat}
    (A : OrderedStructure σ) (q : Fin m → Fin A.size) (R) :
    ParameterizedRules.operator (NonemptyReadRules.rules tm σ m d w) A q R ⊆
      ParameterizedRules.operator (rules tm σ m d w) A q R
proof:
:=
  fun out ho => (operator_iff tm A q R out).mpr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr ho))))

name: Lax979537Proofs.TransitionRules.preserves
statement:
theorem preserves {f : List Bool → Bool} (h : TM2ComputableInPolyTime id (fun b : Bool => [b]) f)
    {σ : Vocabulary} {m : Nat} (d : Nat) (A : PointedStructure σ m)
    (hn : TraceCodes.threshold h.tm σ m ≤ A.structureValue.size) :
    ParameterizedRules.operator (rules h.tm σ m d (TraceCodes.nodeWidth σ d))
      A.structureValue A.tuple (TraceCodes.encoded h d A hn) ⊆ TraceCodes.encoded h d A hn
proof:
:= by
  intro out ho
  rcases (operator_iff h.tm A.structureValue A.tuple _ out).mp ho with ho | ho | ho | ho | ho
  · exact PlainClosure.preserves h d A hn ho
  · exact PushClosure.preserves h d A hn false ho
  · exact PushClosure.preserves h d A hn true ho
  · exact EmptyReadClosure.preserves h d A hn ho
  · exact NonemptyReadClosure.preserves h d A hn ho

name: Lax979537Proofs.TupleAddresses.address_succ
statement:
theorem address_succ (n k : Nat) (a : Fin (k + 1) → Fin n) :
    (address n (k + 1) a).val = (address n k (Fin.tail a)).val +
      n ^ k * (a 0).val
proof: := rfl

name: Lax979537Proofs.TupleAddresses.lex_succ
statement:
theorem lex_succ {n k : Nat} (a b : Fin (k + 1) → Fin n) :
    TupleLex a b ↔ a 0 < b 0 ∨
      (a 0 = b 0 ∧ TupleLex (Fin.tail a) (Fin.tail b))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, hp⟩
    refine Fin.cases ?_ ?_ i hi hp
    · intro hi _
      exact Or.inl hi
    · intro j hi hp
      refine Or.inr ⟨hp 0 (by simp), j, hi, ?_⟩
      intro l hl
      exact hp l.succ (Fin.succ_lt_succ_iff.mpr hl)
  · rintro (h | ⟨h, j, hj, hp⟩)
    · exact ⟨0, h, fun i hi => (Fin.not_lt_zero i hi).elim⟩
    · refine ⟨j.succ, hj, ?_⟩
      intro i
      refine Fin.cases ?_ ?_ i
      · exact fun _ => h
      · intro l hl
        exact hp l (Fin.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp hl)

name: Lax979537Proofs.TupleAddresses.address_lt_iff
statement:
theorem address_lt_iff (n k : Nat) (a b : Fin k → Fin n) :
    address n k a < address n k b ↔ TupleLex a b
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      have he : a = b := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      subst b
      constructor
      · intro h
        exact (Nat.lt_irrefl _ h).elim
      · rintro ⟨i, _, _⟩
        exact Fin.elim0 i
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [lex_succ]
      have ha := (address n k (Fin.tail a)).isLt
      have hb := (address n k (Fin.tail b)).isLt
      change (address n (k + 1) a).val < (address n (k + 1) b).val ↔ _
      rw [address_succ, address_succ]
      rcases lt_trichotomy (a 0) (b 0) with h | h | h
      · have hmul : n ^ k * (a 0).val + n ^ k ≤ n ^ k * (b 0).val := by
          simpa only [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one] using
            Nat.mul_le_mul_left (n ^ k) (Nat.succ_le_of_lt h)
        constructor
        · exact fun _ => Or.inl h
        · intro _
          omega
      · simp only [h, lt_self_iff_false, false_or, true_and,
          Nat.add_lt_add_iff_right]
        exact ih (Fin.tail a) (Fin.tail b)
      · have hmul : n ^ k * (b 0).val + n ^ k ≤ n ^ k * (a 0).val := by
          simpa only [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one] using
            Nat.mul_le_mul_left (n ^ k) (Nat.succ_le_of_lt h)
        constructor
        · intro hh
          omega
        · rintro (hh | ⟨hh, _⟩)
          · exact (lt_asymm h hh).elim
          · exact (ne_of_gt h hh).elim

/

name: Lax979537Proofs.TupleAddresses.eval_lex_address
statement:
theorem eval_lex_address {σ : Vocabulary} {m k : Nat} {ρ : List Nat}
    (x y : Fin k → Fin m) (A : OrderedStructure σ)
    (v : Fin m → Fin A.size) (η : RelationEnv A.size ρ) :
    eval (lexFormula x y) A v η ↔
      address A.size k (v ∘ x) < address A.size k (v ∘ y)
proof:
:=
  (eval_lexFormula x y A v η).trans (address_lt_iff _ _ _ _).symm

name: Lax979537Proofs.TupleCoding.pad_get
statement:
theorem pad_get {n k w : Nat} (zero : Fin n) (x : Fin k → Fin n) (h : k ≤ w) (i : Fin k) :
    pad (w := w) zero x (Fin.castLE h i) = x i
proof: := by simp [pad, i.isLt]

name: Lax979537Proofs.TupleCoding.pad_injective
statement:
theorem pad_injective {n k w : Nat} (zero : Fin n) (h : k ≤ w) :
    Function.Injective (pad (n := n) (k := k) (w := w) zero)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y he
  funext i
  simpa only [pad_get] using congrFun he (Fin.castLE h i)

name: Lax979537Proofs.TupleCoding.finiteTag_lt
statement: theorem finiteTag_lt {α : Type} [Fintype α] (a : α) : finiteTag a < Fintype.card α
proof:
:=
  (Fintype.equivFin α a).isLt

name: Lax979537Proofs.TupleCoding.finiteTag_injective
statement: theorem finiteTag_injective {α : Type} [Fintype α] : Function.Injective (finiteTag (α := α))
proof:
:= by
  intro a b h
  exact (Fintype.equivFin α).injective (Fin.ext h)

name: Lax979537Proofs.TupleCoding.finiteCode_injective
statement:
theorem finiteCode_injective {α : Type} [Fintype α] {n : Nat} (hn : Fintype.card α ≤ n) :
    Function.Injective (finiteCode hn)
proof:
:= fun _ _ h =>
  finiteTag_injective (congrArg (fun x : Fin n => x.val) h)

/

name: Lax979537Proofs.TupleCoding.finiteGuard_firstOrder
proof:
:=
  AddressFormulas.numeral_firstOrder _ _

name: Lax979537Proofs.TupleCoding.eval_finiteGuard
statement:
theorem eval_finiteGuard {σ : Vocabulary} {v : Nat} {ρ : List Nat}
    {α : Type} [Fintype α] (c : α) (x : Fin v) (A : OrderedStructure σ)
    (hn : Fintype.card α ≤ A.size) (a : Fin v → Fin A.size) (η : RelationEnv A.size ρ) :
    eval (finiteGuard c x) A a η ↔ a x = finiteCode hn c
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteGuard, AddressFormulas.eval_numeral]
  constructor
  · intro h; apply Fin.ext; exact h
  · intro h; exact congrArg (fun x : Fin A.size => x.val) h

name: Lax979537Proofs.TupleCoding.clock_address
statement:
theorem clock_address {n d : Nat} (hn : 0 < n) (t : Nat) :
    (TupleAddresses.address n d (clock hn t)).val = t % n ^ d
proof: := by simp [clock]

name: Lax979537Proofs.TupleCoding.clock_injective
statement:
theorem clock_injective {n d : Nat} (hn : 0 < n) {s t : Nat}
    (hs : s < n ^ d) (ht : t < n ^ d) (he : clock (d := d) hn s = clock hn t) : s = t
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun x => (TupleAddresses.address n d x).val) he
  simpa only [clock_address, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hs, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt ht] using h

name: Lax979537Proofs.TupleCoding.rows_get
statement:
theorem rows_get {K : Type} {c w n : Nat} (keys : K ≃ Fin c) (f : K → Fin w → Fin n)
    (k : K) (j : Fin w) : rows keys f (finProdFinEquiv (keys k, j)) = f k j
proof:
:= by
  simp [rows]

name: Lax979537Proofs.TupleCoding.rows_injective
statement:
theorem rows_injective {K : Type} {c w n : Nat} (keys : K ≃ Fin c) :
    Function.Injective (rows (w := w) (n := n) keys)
proof:
:= by
  intro f g he
  funext k j
  simpa only [rows_get] using congrFun he (finProdFinEquiv (keys k, j))

name: Lax979537Proofs.TupleCoding.append_inj
statement:
theorem append_inj {α : Type} {k m : Nat} {x y : Fin k → α} {u v : Fin m → α}
    (h : Fin.append x u = Fin.append y v) : x = y ∧ u = v
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · funext i; simpa only [Fin.append_left] using congrFun h (Fin.castAdd m i)
  · funext i; simpa only [Fin.append_right] using congrFun h (Fin.natAdd k i)

name: Lax979537Proofs.TupleCoordinates.coordinate_ofFn
statement:
theorem coordinate_ofFn (base : α → BitStore K Aux) {k : Nat}
    (counter coord : Fin k → K)
    (hsep : (ports (List.ofFn (fun i => (counter i, coord i)))).Nodup)
    (values : Fin k → Nat) (a : α) (remaining : List Nat) (scratch : Option Bool) (i : Fin k) :
    (packTuple base (List.ofFn (fun i => (counter i, coord i))) a (List.ofFn values) remaining scratch).stk
      (coord i) = List.replicate (values i) true
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing base remaining with
  | zero => exact Fin.elim0 i
  | succ k ih =>
      have hs : List.ofFn (fun i => (counter i, coord i)) =
          (counter 0, coord 0) :: List.ofFn (fun j : Fin k => (counter j.succ, coord j.succ)) := by
        rw [List.ofFn_succ]
      have hv : List.ofFn values = values 0 :: List.ofFn (fun j : Fin k => values j.succ) := by
        rw [List.ofFn_succ]
      rw [hs] at hsep ⊢
      rw [hv]
      have hn : counter 0 ≠ coord 0 ∧
          counter 0 ∉ ports (List.ofFn (fun j : Fin k => (counter j.succ, coord j.succ))) ∧
          coord 0 ∉ ports (List.ofFn (fun j : Fin k => (counter j.succ, coord j.succ))) ∧
          (ports (List.ofFn (fun j : Fin k => (counter j.succ, coord j.succ)))).Nodup := by
        simpa only [ports, List.flatMap_cons, List.cons_append, List.nil_append,
          List.nodup_cons, List.mem_cons, not_or, and_assoc] using hsep
      simp only [packTuple, List.headD_cons, List.tail_cons]
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
      · rw [packTuple_fresh _ _ (coord 0) hn.2.2.1]
        simp [pack, working]
      · exact ih _ (fun j => counter j.succ) (fun j => coord j.succ) hn.2.2.2
          (fun j => values j.succ) remaining.tail j

name: Lax979537Proofs.TupleOrder.eval_disj
statement:
theorem eval_disj {σ : Vocabulary} {m : Nat} {ρ : List Nat}
    (φ ψ : RawFormula σ m ρ) (A : OrderedStructure σ)
    (v : Fin m → Fin A.size) (η : RelationEnv A.size ρ) :
    eval (disj φ ψ) A v η ↔ eval φ A v η ∨ eval ψ A v η
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases h : eval φ A v η <;> simp [disj, eval, h]

name: Lax979537Proofs.TupleOrder.eval_allOf
statement:
theorem eval_allOf {σ : Vocabulary} {m : Nat} {ρ : List Nat}
    (fs : List (RawFormula σ m ρ)) (A : OrderedStructure σ)
    (v : Fin m → Fin A.size) (η : RelationEnv A.size ρ) :
    eval (allOf fs) A v η ↔ ∀ φ ∈ fs, eval φ A v η
proof:
:= by
  induction fs with
  | nil => simp [allOf, eval]
  | cons φ fs ih => simp [allOf, eval, ih]

name: Lax979537Proofs.TupleOrder.eval_anyOf
statement:
theorem eval_anyOf {σ : Vocabulary} {m : Nat} {ρ : List Nat}
    (fs : List (RawFormula σ m ρ)) (A : OrderedStructure σ)
    (v : Fin m → Fin A.size) (η : RelationEnv A.size ρ) :
    eval (anyOf fs) A v η ↔ ∃ φ ∈ fs, eval φ A v η
proof:
:= by
  induction fs with
  | nil => simp [anyOf, eval]
  | cons φ fs ih => simp [anyOf, eval_disj, ih]

name: Lax979537Proofs.TupleOrder.admissible_allOf
proof:
:= by
  induction fs with
  | nil => simp [allOf, RawFormula.Admissible]
  | cons φ fs ih => simp [allOf, RawFormula.Admissible, ih]

name: Lax979537Proofs.TupleOrder.admissible_anyOf
proof:
:= by
  induction fs with
  | nil => simp [anyOf, RawFormula.Admissible]
  | cons φ fs ih => simp [anyOf, disj, RawFormula.Admissible, ih]

/
is independent of the size of the input structure. -/

name: Lax979537Proofs.TupleOrder.exists_map
statement:
theorem exists_map {α β : Type} (xs : List α) (f : α → β) (P : β → Prop) :
    (∃ y ∈ xs.map f, P y) ↔ ∃ x ∈ xs, P (f x)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, hp⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hy
    exact ⟨x, hx, hp⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, hp⟩
    exact ⟨f x, List.mem_map.mpr ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, hp⟩

name: Lax979537Proofs.TupleOrder.lexFormula_admissible
statement:
theorem lexFormula_admissible {σ : Vocabulary} {m k : Nat} {ρ : List Nat}
    (x y : Fin k → Fin m) : (lexFormula (σ := σ) (ρ := ρ) x y).Admissible
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lexFormula, admissible_anyOf, List.forall_mem_map, List.mem_finRange,
    forall_const, RawFormula.Admissible, true_and, admissible_allOf]
  intro i j
  by_cases h : j < i <;> simp [h, RawFormula.Admissible]

name: Lax979537Proofs.TupleOrder.eval_lexFormula
statement:
theorem eval_lexFormula {σ : Vocabulary} {m k : Nat} {ρ : List Nat}
    (x y : Fin k → Fin m) (A : OrderedStructure σ)
    (v : Fin m → Fin A.size) (η : RelationEnv A.size ρ) :
    eval (lexFormula x y) A v η ↔ TupleLex (v ∘ x) (v ∘ y)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lexFormula, eval_anyOf, exists_map, List.mem_finRange,
    true_and, eval, eval_allOf, List.forall_mem_map, forall_const, TupleLex,
    Function.comp_apply]
  apply exists_congr
  intro i
  apply and_congr_right
  intro _
  apply forall_congr'
  intro j
  by_cases h : j < i <;> simp [h, eval]

name: Lax979537Proofs.TupleRank.fold_horner
statement:
theorem fold_horner (n a : Nat) (values : List Nat) :
    values.foldl (fun a v => n * a + v) a = a * n ^ values.length + weighted n values
proof:
:= by
  induction values generalizing a with
  | nil => simp [weighted]
  | cons v values ih =>
      rw [List.foldl_cons, ih]
      simp only [List.length_cons, weighted, pow_succ]
      ring

name: Lax979537Proofs.TupleRank.tupleValues_length
statement: theorem tupleValues_length {n k : Nat} (v : Fin k → Fin n) : (tupleValues v).length = k
proof:
:= by
  simp [tupleValues]

name: Lax979537Proofs.TupleRank.tupleValues_succ
statement:
theorem tupleValues_succ {n k : Nat} (v : Fin (k + 1) → Fin n) :
    tupleValues v = (v 0).val :: tupleValues (Fin.tail v)
proof:
:= by
  simp [tupleValues, List.ofFn_succ, Fin.tail]

name: Lax979537Proofs.TupleRank.weighted_address
statement:
theorem weighted_address (n k : Nat) (v : Fin k → Fin n) :
    weighted n (tupleValues v) = (address n k v).val
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      have h := (address n 0 v).isLt
      simp only [pow_zero] at h
      simp only [tupleValues, List.ofFn_zero, weighted]
      omega
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [tupleValues_succ, weighted, tupleValues_length, ih, address_succ]
      ring

name: Lax979537Proofs.TupleRank.rank_address
statement:
theorem rank_address (n k : Nat) (v : Fin k → Fin n) :
    rank n (tupleValues v) = (address n k v).val
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rank, fold_horner, Nat.zero_mul, Nat.zero_add]
  exact weighted_address n k v

name: Lax979537Proofs.TupleRank.value_eq_rank
statement:
theorem value_eq_rank {K : Type} (n : Nat) (coords : List K) (v : K → Nat) :
    StackIndex.value n coords v 0 = rank n (coords.map v)
proof:
:= by
  simp [StackIndex.value, rank, List.foldl_map]

name: Lax979537Proofs.TupleRank.rank_lt
statement: theorem rank_lt (n k : Nat) (v : Fin k → Fin n) : rank n (tupleValues v) < n ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [rank_address]
  exact (address n k v).isLt

/

name: Lax979537Proofs.TupleRank.getElem?_blocks
statement:
theorem getElem?_blocks {α β : Type} (xs : List α) (f : α → List β) (m : Nat)
    (hlen : ∀ x ∈ xs, (f x).length = m) (i j : Nat) (hj : j < m) :
    (xs.flatMap f)[i * m + j]? = (xs[i]?).bind (fun x => (f x)[j]?)
proof:
:= by
  induction xs generalizing i with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
      have hx := hlen x (by simp)
      have ht : ∀ x ∈ xs, (f x).length = m := fun x hm => hlen x (by simp [hm])
      cases i with
      | zero =>
          simp only [Nat.zero_mul, Nat.zero_add, List.flatMap_cons, List.getElem?_cons_zero,
            Option.bind_some]
          exact List.getElem?_append_left (by omega)
      | succ i =>
          rw [List.flatMap_cons, List.getElem?_append_right (by rw [hx, Nat.succ_mul]; omega)]
          have he : (i + 1) * m + j - (f x).length = i * m + j := by rw [hx, Nat.succ_mul]; omega
          rw [he, ih ht]
          rfl

/
canonical encoding enumeration, without a sorting or permutation assumption. -/

name: Lax979537Proofs.TupleRank.canonical_at_address
statement:
theorem canonical_at_address (n k : Nat) (v : Fin k → Fin n) :
    (Lax979537.StructureEncoding.tuples n k)[(address n k v).val]? = some v
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      have hz : (address n 0 v).val = 0 := by
        have h := (address n 0 v).isLt
        simp only [pow_zero] at h
        omega
      rw [hz]
      have hv : v = Fin.elim0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      simp [Lax979537.StructureEncoding.tuples, hv]
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [Lax979537.StructureEncoding.tuples, address_succ]
      have he : (address n k (Fin.tail v)).val + n ^ k * (v 0).val =
          (v 0).val * n ^ k + (address n k (Fin.tail v)).val := by ring
      rw [he, getElem?_blocks (List.finRange n)
        (fun (a : Fin n) => (Lax979537.StructureEncoding.tuples n k).map
          (fun (t : Fin k → Fin n) => (Fin.cons a t : Fin (k + 1) → Fin n))) (n ^ k)
        (by intro a ha; simp [StructureEncoding.tuples_length]) (v 0).val
        (address n k (Fin.tail v)).val (address n k (Fin.tail v)).isLt]
      have hget : (List.finRange n)[(v 0).val]? = some (v 0) := by simp
      rw [hget]
      simp only [Option.bind_some, List.getElem?_map, ih]
      simp [Fin.cons_self_tail]

name: Lax979537Proofs.TupleRank.table_at_rank
statement:
theorem table_at_rank {n k : Nat} (p : (Fin k → Fin n) → Bool) (v : Fin k → Fin n) :
    ((Lax979537.StructureEncoding.tuples n k).map p)[rank n (tupleValues v)]? = some (p v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rank_address, List.getElem?_map, canonical_at_address]
  rfl
